text: Verdict: TEST-FIRST (hypothesis-grade). G2 Rancidity / lipase: FFA not measured: titrate free fatty acids / acid value. G3 Heavy metals: inorganic As not measured (ICP-MS). The leading chain is stabilise then ae iep, giving an isolate with about 88.5% protein and a 100% chance of meeting your spec. Our cost is about ₹233 per kg protein (a lower bound, because some process costs have no data yet), against ₹595 for imported pea isolate landed in India. The test to buy first is Proximate + Kjeldahl protein, worth about ₹11,563 per decision. Decision support only; confirm FSSAI classification.
